name: [ASCENSIONS] Forge & Slay!
desc:
⚠️PLEASE REPORT BUGS ON THE GROUP WALL!⚠️

🔥 Welcome to Forge & Slay! 🔥

Step into the blacksmith’s forge and create weapons like no other. 
Mine ores, crack open geodes, smelt powerful metals, and craft swords to prove your strength! 

[How To Play]
• Collect ores from the world!
• Smelt them into molten ingots!
• Forge epic swords!
• Hire hunters to fight monsters and bring back rewards!
• Upgrade your forge for more power!
